name: io.github.makelele29/odoo-safe-mcp
title: Odoo Safe MCP
description: Deterministic AI firewall & MCP server for Odoo 14-20 with GDPR PII redaction, guarded drafts, and zero-credential Slack/Teams/Telegram approvals.

environmentVariables.name: ODOO_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Odoo instance (e.g. https://company.odoo.com or http://127.0.0.1:8069).

environmentVariables.name: ODOO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Odoo API key for the AI bot user (stays local, never sent to Guard Cloud).

environmentVariables.name: ODOO_SAFE_GUARD_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Pro/Business licence key for Slack/Teams/Telegram human approvals and audit log.

environmentVariables.name: ODOO_PII_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Optional GDPR PII shield for reads: off, mask, or strict.

environmentVariables.name: ODOO_ALLOWED_COMPANY_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated Odoo company IDs to lock all queries and writes.

environmentVariables.name: ODOO_DRAFT_MAX_AMOUNT
environmentVariables.description: Optional max total amount for auto-approved drafts before escalating to human approval.
